techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts.
techniques.detection_strategy_name: Detection of Valid Account Abuse Across Platforms
techniques.rationale: An identity-anomaly stage built from an unusual authentication event is mapped to Valid Accounts as a candidate behavioral technique; the engine does not assert credential theft itself.

techniques.name: Data from Local System
techniques.description: Adversaries may search local system sources to find files of interest and sensitive data prior to Exfiltration.
techniques.detection_strategy_name: Detection of Local Data Collection Prior to Exfiltration
techniques.rationale: A sensitive local resource access is mapped to local-data collection because the stage represents acquisition of sensitive data before a removable-media transfer.

techniques.name: Exfiltration over USB
techniques.description: Adversaries may attempt to exfiltrate data over a USB connected physical device.
techniques.rationale: A removable-media mount followed by a large copy to a USB destination provides direct evidence for physical-medium exfiltration over USB.
